rows.resolution_note: Rule E: the sentence attributes the replication dataset to reference 53 (Sakaue 2021, DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00931-x, the source of three dictionary rows) and names it Biobank Japan (BBJ) alone with its own case and control counts, which separates the BioBank Japan-only row from the European and cross-population rows; the BUN and eGFR meta-analysis of BBJ with the Taiwan Biobank is a different dataset attributed to reference 55 and is not a conflict.
rows.quote: We replicated the results of the primary analysis in two independent datasets: Biobank Japan (BBJ) [53] (2117 cases and 174,345 controls) and J-Kidney-Biobank (JKB) [54] (382 cases of CKD in the J-Kidney-Biobank and 3471 controls participating in the TMM Comm-Cohort Study (JKB-ToMMo)).
